# `protocols` package: architecture note excerpt

Full note: `knowledge/architecture/protocols.md`; update it in the same change (skill `notes`).

## Responsibility

- `typing.Protocol` contracts each plugin kind satisfies structurally, plus runtime-checkable capability protocols the pipeline tests with `isinstance` instead of probing attributes (Capability protocol (`knowledge/concepts/Capability protocol.md`)).

## Invariants

- A plugin that satisfies the protocols works without subclassing; capabilities are optional and detected with `isinstance`.
- The orchestrator has no estimator-name switch: every estimator exposes `estimate_attributions`, and two-phase estimators are found by `TwoPhaseEstimator`.

## Known issues

- None open.
